shelter_gate.Location: the kennel yard, chain gate, a gravel apron before open pavement
shelter_gate.PursuerType: a kennel hand with a slip lead, not angry, just quick
shelter_gate.EscapeCondition: reach the gap in the gate on the beat the lead swings away
shelter_gate.FailCondition: the lead lands on the collar and the run restarts at the pen
shelter_gate.PlayerSees: The hand lifts. The lead swings. For one beat there is nothing between the gap and the gravel.

alley_chase.Location: a brick alley behind a row of shops, bins down both sides
alley_chase.PursuerType: a loose yard dog, bigger, faster in a straight line and only in a straight line
alley_chase.EscapeCondition: put two bins between the pursuer and the dog, then break the opposite way
alley_chase.FailCondition: taken on the shoulder; the run continues on a shorter stamina bar
alley_chase.PlayerSees: It commits to the right. The bins on the left stop being scenery.

road_crossing.Location: four lanes, no signal, a raised kerb on the far side
road_crossing.PursuerType: none; the traffic is the hazard and it is not interested
road_crossing.EscapeCondition: cross on the second gap, because the first one closes early
road_crossing.FailCondition: driven back to the kerb; one full cycle is lost and the light is going
road_crossing.PlayerSees: Two gaps arrive. The first is wide and short. The second is narrow and long enough.

train_leap.Location: the freight line at the edge of the yard, gravel siding, cars moving at a walk
train_leap.PursuerType: a yard dog working the siding, close but committed to the ground
train_leap.EscapeCondition: match the boxcar for three tiles and commit to the open door
train_leap.FailCondition: the door passes; the next car is a flat and the approach restarts
train_leap.PlayerSees: The door is a moving hole. It is open for four steps and then it is a wall again.

diner_yard.Location: the back lot of a roadside diner, one propped door, a stack of crates
diner_yard.PursuerType: none; a cook who has not decided about the dog yet
diner_yard.EscapeCondition: hold inside the window without breaking cover and the tray comes out
diner_yard.FailCondition: break early and the door shuts; no food, no damage, no second offer
diner_yard.PlayerSees: Nothing is chasing. The cost of running is that the door closes.

fence_line.Location: a chain link run behind the last houses, one gap dug under the bottom rail
fence_line.PursuerType: two dogs on the far side, working the wire in step with each other
fence_line.EscapeCondition: take the gap on the beat when both dogs are moving the same way
fence_line.FailCondition: the wire takes the back leg; the limp starts here and does not clear
fence_line.PlayerSees: Two dogs pacing one wire, in step. In step means there is a beat when neither is at the gap.

phase_yard.Light: one warm cone from the house, wet grass inside it, everything outside it blue
phase_yard.SoundBed: a television two rooms away, and a cooling fan that is not a dog
Props: a hose coiled on its reel
a low chain fence at the property line
a rubber ball gone flat with age
phase_yard.GateOpenMoment: at 33% the side gate swings and the warm light stops reaching
phase_yard.PlayerSees: The one shape of ground the dog already knows, and the machine knows it better.
phase_yard.NemesisPressure: low; it holds the middle and lets the fence do the work

phase_fence_gap.Light: no house light past the gate, one neighbour's lamp on a motion timer that keeps guessing wrong
phase_fence_gap.SoundBed: chain link ringing whenever either animal touches it
Props: a chain link run between two yards
a gap dug under the bottom rail
a lamp pole with a dead sensor
phase_fence_gap.GateOpenMoment: at 66% the far panel is already down and the ground turns to ballast
phase_fence_gap.PlayerSees: The same shape of gap that took the back leg, with the machine standing in it.
phase_fence_gap.NemesisPressure: rising; it sprints once a phase and pays for it out of charge

phase_train_yard.Light: sodium floods on tall poles, hard shadows that swing when nothing has moved
phase_train_yard.SoundBed: an idling engine out of sight, couplings taking up slack one at a time
Props: a switch stand with its lamp lit
one boxcar with the door standing open
phase_train_yard.GateOpenMoment: no gate; this phase ends the fight one way or the other
phase_train_yard.PlayerSees: An open boxcar door, the same shape that saved the dog once, and this time the machine is in front of it.
phase_train_yard.NemesisPressure: highest; charge is low, the reads are clipped, and it stops covering both exits
